# Dailymotion

> The home for videos that matter - A global video platform where you can discover, watch, and share content that enriches and inspires

## About

Founded in Paris in 2005, Dailymotion is a leading video-sharing platform available in 190 countries and 45 languages. With over 400 million unique monthly users and 4 billion monthly video views, Dailymotion connects audiences with meaningful content across news, sports, music, and entertainment.

As a CANAL+ company and part of the Vivendi Group, Dailymotion operates under European values and privacy standards, offering an alternative to American and Asian video platforms.

## Our Mission

Dailymotion is redefining video consumption to make screen time meaningful, inclusive, and enriching. We build bridges between cultures and perspectives, foster freedom of speech, and create a safe, empathetic community where content inspires curiosity, joy, and growth.

**For whom:**
- **Creators & Media**: Tools and support to express passion and build audiences
- **Viewers**: A safe space to discover content that matters
- **Society**: Contributing to a more open, respectful digital world

## Platform Statistics

- **400M+** unique monthly users worldwide
- **4B+** monthly video views
- **190** countries served
- **45** localized versions of the site

## Content & Discovery

### Main Categories
- **News & Politics**: Breaking news, current events, investigative journalism
- **Sports**: Live competitions, highlights, analysis, and athlete content
- **Music**: Music videos, concerts, festivals, and artist content
- **Entertainment**: Shows, comedy, interviews, and cultural events

### Additional Content
- Gaming & Esports
- Lifestyle, Fashion & Wellness
- Technology & Innovation
- Education & Documentaries

### How to Discover Content
- Personalized video recommendations
- Curated channels by topics and creators
- Trending videos by category
- Search functionality
- Available on web, mobile apps, and connected TV

## For Creators

### Why Create on Dailymotion?

**Global Reach**
Connect with a passionate international audience across 191 countries. 75% of 18-24 year-olds believe social networks harm intelligence - Dailymotion offers meaningful content discovery instead.

**Fair Monetization**
Industry-leading revenue-sharing model with transparent, profitable monetization for quality content creators.

**Advanced Creator Tools**
- **AI-powered metadata generation** - automatically create optimized titles, descriptions, and tags
- Automated video subtitles
- Advanced analytics dashboard
- Channel and playlist management
- Monetization controls
- Video protection and content security

**Better Support**
Join thousands of creators who benefit from Dailymotion's creator support program with dedicated assistance, training, and resources.

## Key Features

### For Viewers
- **Free access** - Ad-supported video streaming with no subscription required
- **HD and 4K streaming** - High-quality video across all devices
- **Cross-device experience** - Watch on desktop, mobile, tablet, and connected TV
- **Multiple languages** - Content and interface in 45 languages
- **Safe environment** - Moderated content with brand safety measures

### Technology
- Advanced video player with adaptive streaming
- Embeddable video player for third-party websites
- Real-time recommendations and contextual matching
- Content protection and security systems
- European data centers with GDPR compliance

## What Makes Dailymotion Different

### European Alternative
A French-based platform operating under EU privacy laws and values, offering an alternative to tech giants while respecting user privacy and data protection.

### Quality-First Approach
Focus on premium content from trusted publishers and professional creators. Fighting fake news, unsafe content, and promoting meaningful video experiences.

### Meaningful Content Philosophy
Making screen time valuable through content that educates, enriches, and inspires - not just viral entertainment. We believe videos should matter.

### Human-Centric Community
A platform that cares about creators and viewers, fostering respectful dialogue and diverse perspectives rather than algorithmic polarization.

### Fair Economics
One of the most profitable and transparent revenue-sharing models in the market, designed to truly support the creator economy.

- **Dailymotion Advertising** (https://dailymotionadvertising.com) - Advanced video advertising solutions for brands
